people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”
translations.bsb: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.”
translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
translations.asv: And Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and bear with you? bring hither thy son.
